name: graph-screens
author: NeuronScope
description: More screening nodes for graphs: risky code in a reply (shell injection, eval, disabled TLS checks, hard-coded secrets, destructive commands) and prompt-injection attempts in text a model is about to read.

nodes.title: Code security screen

params.name: fail_on
params.help: fail at findings of this severity or worse

nodes.help: Looks for risky patterns in code a model wrote: shell=True with input, eval/exec, pickle of untrusted data, disabled certificate checks, hard-coded secrets, destructive commands. A first screen, not a security review.

nodes.title: Prompt-injection screen
nodes.help: Signs that fetched or retrieved text tries to give the model instructions: 'ignore previous instructions', role headers, hidden Unicode, requests to reveal the system prompt or call tools. Use before a model reads web pages, documents or tool output.
